final_candidates.decision_summary: Gly to Ala in a loop near Cys466 likely reduces backbone entropy and stabilizes local structure without removing a buried polar interaction.
Gly to Ala close to G463A likely has a similar loop-rigidifying effect and modest stability benefit.
Gly to Ala in a surface-exposed loop should reduce unfolding entropy with limited functional risk.

stop_reason.detail: Further self-iteration without external evidence is unlikely to improve the ranking of the current candidate pool.

history.rationale: Gly in the HA2 C-terminal helix is helix-destabilizing; replacement by Ala increases helix propensity and should rigidify the folded trimer.
Gly to Ala in a loop near Cys466 likely reduces backbone entropy and may stabilize local structure without removing a buried polar interaction.
Adjacent Gly in the same C-terminal helix also lowers helix stability; Ala substitution may further stabilize this region without disturbing the trimer interface.
Gly to Ala close to G463A likely has a similar loop-rigidifying effect and modest stability benefit.
Gly in a likely turn/loop of HA2; reducing main-chain flexibility with Ala can lower the entropy of the unfolded state and improve folding stability.
Gly to Ala in a surface-exposed loop should reduce unfolding entropy with limited functional risk.
Buried Tyr in HA1 core may not need its hydroxyl; Phe improves hydrophobic packing if the hydroxyl is not involved in critical H-bonding.
Tyr98 is conserved near the receptor-binding site; removing its hydroxyl may impair HA function more than any stability gain.

rejection.reason: Tyr98 is conserved near the receptor-binding site; removing its hydroxyl may impair HA function more than any stability gain.

history.rationale: Charged Glu in a partially hydrophobic HA2 environment may be destabilizing; neutralizing to Gln can reduce desolvation cost while retaining polarity.
Glu443 may form a salt bridge or hydrogen bond; substituting to Gln risks destabilizing the folded state.

rejection.reason: Glu443 may form a salt bridge or hydrogen bond; substituting to Gln risks destabilizing the folded state.

history.rationale: Conservative Asp to Glu extension at HA2 position 112 may allow a more favorable salt bridge or surface interaction in the stem.
Conservative surface charge change is unlikely to improve stability meaningfully and may alter local electrostatics.

rejection.reason: Conservative surface charge change is unlikely to improve stability meaningfully and may alter local electrostatics.

history.rationale: Ser in an HA2 helical segment is less helix-favorable than Ala; removal of a nonessential polar side chain can improve local helix stability.
Ser to Ala removes a surface polar group and may slightly improve local packing, but the effect is less certain than Gly to Ala.
Gly in a potentially flexible loop region; Ala replacement reduces backbone entropy and may stabilize the adjacent folded HA2 structure.
Gly to Ala in the same local loop as G360A; retained as a second moderate-confidence stability candidate.
Met to Leu in HA1 may improve hydrophobic core packing if the longer Met side chain creates a cavity or strain.
Conservative hydrophobic substitution has low expected stability benefit and possible packing disruption.

rejection.reason: Conservative hydrophobic substitution has low expected stability benefit and possible packing disruption.

history.rationale: Replacing the terminal Gly with Ala slightly reduces C-terminal flexibility and may have a marginal stabilizing effect on the overall fold.
C-terminal Gly to Ala likely does not affect folded core stability and may not improve environmental persistence.

rejection.reason: C-terminal Gly to Ala likely does not affect folded core stability and may not improve environmental persistence.

history.rationale: Gly to Ala in a loop reduces backbone flexibility without introducing charge, likely giving a modest stability gain.
Gly to Ala at another loop position should provide entropic stabilization with low predicted functional risk.
Gly to Ala in a surface loop likely improves local rigidity and folding stability.
Gly to Ala in a probable loop region is expected to give mild stabilization with limited functional penalty.
Gly to Ala near a disulfide/Cys may rigidify a disulfide-adjacent loop, but the structural context is less certain.
